text:
maya: deploy-bot flagged the gateway chart upgrade (chart gateway v2.3.0 -> v2.4.0) failing health checks in the us-west-2 canary. 2/3 pods Ready, repeated liveness restarts. Change window ends in ~36m. Do we pin to v2.3.1, roll back to v2.3.0, or try an image-only hotfix? Need quick decision and release notes wording.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary check FAILED for chart=infra/gateway, release=gateway-canary, ns=prod-canary. Observed: pod restarts, readiness probe backoff. See logs: https://logs.redwood/gateway/1958004321
```
FAIL: gateway-canary-2 not ready (RestartCount=8)
  Liveness: /healthz failed: connection refused
  Event: Back-off restarting failed container
```
jack: my vote is pin to chart v2.3.1 (patch) then rollforward when we confirm root cause. Patch-level pin avoids DB migration drift. Also update release notes: note the pin + follow-up validation after window. :thumbsup:
linh: logs show OOMs in gateway-worker and CPU spike on canary during startup. I suspect a default `resources` change in v2.4.0 values. If that's true, pin is safest. If we can reproduce locally quick, we can test v2.4.0 with patched values.
ryan: quick check: is there any image digest change between versions? If it's an image-only regression we could deploy image rollback to the canary rather than full chart rollback. But helm chart bump changed init containers too.
maya: @ryan ok — can you validate image digest and whether the failing container is from the new image or a changed init script? Also please draft a one-line for CS: "Canary deployment for Gateway was pinned to previous chart due to health regressions; no data migrations applied."
sre-oncall: from runbook: recommend pin-to-patch for now. Command to pin (example):
```
helm upgrade gateway --reuse-values infra/gateway --version 2.3.1 -n prod-canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/gateway-canary -n prod-canary
```
We'll monitor traces and CPU/mem. If canary stabilizes, we keep pin and schedule canary-heavy tests in staging later.
jack: I'll run the helm upgrade now and also add a short note in the changelog. doing it in 2m.
deploy-bot: [automated] Action started by jack: helm upgrade gateway --version 2.3.1 -n prod-canary
maya: thanks. once canary is stable, update release notes and mark this as "pin applied during change window" in the release PR. I'll also add a follow-up ticket to root-cause v2.4.0 resource defaults.
linh: ack, watching metrics. will post if any regression continues.
ryan: checked image digests — image stayed same, init script in chart changed default env which likely expands memory usage. will add diff in the issue.
maya: closing decision: pin->monitor. if canary remains unhealthy after pin, we escalate to rollback and notify customers. update docs + release notes accordingly. :white_check_mark:"
